title: ranunculus japonicus var. propinquus
intro: Ranunculus japonicus var. propinquus, commonly known as Creeping Buttercup, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Ranunculaceae family, characterized by its yellow flowers and spreading habit. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote healing and reduce inflammation, providing several health benefits such as wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Creeping Buttercup include anti-edematous, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, which contribute to its use in treating various skin conditions and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Ranunculus japonicus var. propinquus include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
